headline: Scientists Find Way to Restore Aging EV Batteries to 95% Capacity
meta_description: New technique restores electric vehicle batteries to 95% of original capacity, offering an alternative to recycling and extending battery life.
summary_short: Instead of breaking down old EV batteries, scientists have developed a restoration method that recovers up to 95% of their original capacity.
body:
Scientists have developed a technique to restore aging electric vehicle batteries to up to 95% of their original capacity, offering a promising alternative to recycling.

The breakthrough means that batteries no longer need to be immediately broken down at the end of their primary vehicle life. Rather than discarding them, this restoration process could give old batteries a second chance at full performance, potentially extending their usefulness and reducing waste in the growing EV industry.

The discovery addresses a critical challenge in the transition to electric vehicles: what to do with batteries as they age. By recovering most of their original power, this method opens new possibilities for battery reuse and could reshape how the industry thinks about end-of-life battery management.
quick_facts: Battery restoration achieves up to 95% of original capacity
Alternative to traditional battery recycling and breakdown
Extends useful life of aging electric vehicle batteries
Reduces waste in the growing EV industry
